MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH DEFINED TERMS DEFECTS

SECTION 1. DEFINITIONS
1.1 "Agreement" means this Master Services Agreement.
1.2 "Confidential Information" means proprietary documentation and data.
1.3 "Force Majeure Event" means acts of God, war, riot, fire, explosion, flood, or earthquake.
1.4 "Subcontractor" means any third-party entity engaged to perform work.
1.5 "Tax Authority" means any national, federal, state, or municipal taxing body.

SECTION 2. OPERATIVE CLAUSES
2.1 Provider shall protect all Confidential Information received from Client.
2.2 Provider shall assign designated Key Personnel to manage the infrastructure.
2.3 The Parties agree that all Proprietary Software remains the sole property of Provider.
2.4 Provider shall meet the agreed Service Level Targets on a monthly basis.
2.5 In the event of a Security Incident, Provider shall immediately alert Client.
2.6 Provider shall indemnify the Indemnified Parties against any copyright claims.
